title: Curved Brougham coachwork and clearer cabin glass
items: The reconstructed Brougham has a continuous curved lower front, darker green and black coachwork, clearer cabin glass and softer empty seat pads. Its accepted lamps, wheels, springs, steps and parked contacts stay in place.
The1893 catalogue guides this one design; hidden upholstery and material optics remain reconstruction. Final photographic and published phone/desktop qualification are still pending.
